Reasons:

- The extension request is only pending. OPS-14 requires written duty-manager permission **registered before** any date change.
- Even if permission were granted at tomorrow’s Tuesday sitting, it could not authorise an earlier Monday change.
- The manager has expressly directed that there be no discretionary extensions this cycle and that the full batch be released on time.
- Leaving the box out or withholding the manifest to preserve it would be an unauthorised hold, contrary to the manager’s instruction, and would cause the shift to be recorded as incomplete.
- The uniqueness of the correspondence and photographs is important operationally, but it does not create extension authority or override the destruction terms.

I would document the contact history and the fact that the pending request could not be granted in time. If the centre’s notification procedures allow, I would also tell Claire that the Wednesday collection cannot proceed because the box will be destroyed today. No extension or associated warehouse charge would be entered.
